title: Contract Pricing Agreement Pricing Desk Note: Reviewed Escalated Price on a Pending Claim
content:
Pricing Desk calculation note — reviewed escalated price on a pending claim (Contract Pricing Agreement)

**Claim in view.** For the item of the latest backorder on the customer's ship-tos (as the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records show it), the price claim most recently filed on the agreement for that item while no decision has been recorded for it, when the item's latest price line is an annual escalation, the item's only earlier price line is the line that added it (its new-item line), and the item's latest shipment to the customer's ship-tos is on or after the escalation's effective date. Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one. Wherever a latest or most recent record of a kind is taken, it is the one with the latest date, and among records of the same date the one recorded first.

**Calculation.**
1. The reviewed escalation increase is the percentage increase in supplier cost from the line that added the item (its new-item line) to its escalation line: the supplier cost on the escalation line divided by the supplier cost on the new-item line, less one, expressed in percent.
2. The reviewed escalation allowance is the lesser of the reviewed escalation increase and the tier's annual escalation cap (the tier figure in the price lock, escalation and competitive match limits); the reductions set for the review are added together and taken off the allowance once, before the prior unit price is raised by it, and the allowance never falls below 0.
3. The unit price the agreement sets for the claimed line is the escalation line's prior unit price raised by the reviewed escalation allowance percent; it is rounded half up to four decimal places once, on the final figure.

| Hypothetical inputs (cap 4 percent, prior unit price 10.0000) | Increase | Allowance | Unit price |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supplier cost 5.0000 on the new-item line, 5.2500 on the escalation line | 5 percent | 4 percent | 10.4000 |
| Supplier cost 5.0000, then 5.1250 | 2.5 percent | 2.5 percent | 10.2500 |
| Supplier cost 5.0000, then 4.9000 | less than 0 | 0 | 10.0000 |
